patch_description:
Replace the simple linear CZ chain with a more expressive ansatz featuring:
1. Parametrized CRY gates for flexible entanglement (instead of fixed CZ)
2. Cross-qubit connectivity to enable richer feature interactions
3. Alternating RX/RY single-qubit rotations for better Bloch sphere coverage
4. Streamlined structure to maintain parameter efficiency while improving expressiveness

This design leverages parametrized two-qubit gates to learn complex feature correlations,
which should improve test accuracy and parameter efficiency. The cross-connectivity ensures
information can flow between distant qubits, reducing the need for many layers.
